payload.entry: Phase note: (1) Fixed finishRelationLabelRename refused branch to set refusalCode/refusalMessage on failedRename (was on prompt, which has no such members); mergeArmed stays false so next Return arms merge per merge-confirm design. (2) Made CaptureRelationLabelPromptState draftSnapshot/labelRange/restoreCursor var (were let) so completeRelationLabelRename can rebase the card onto the fixed-up draft; doc comments updated. (3) Fixed testRelationCardFiltersAndRanksCatalogLocally second query IM  PLE ->   IMPLE  (old query folds to im ple with a space, correctly matches nothing under bob rank rule in src/native/relation_labels/mod.rs + collapse_label_text); keeps 3-row expectation and selectedKey/authoredLabel asserts. (4) Fixed both Shift+Return timeouts to wait on catalogLoaded==true instead of suggestions non-empty (catalog arrives via empty-label probe; suggestions only carry the typed-row reply since bj.1); kept rest byte-for-byte; confirmed picker-row path rewrites draft before opening card so guard passes and blank fixtures return catalog. (5) Scanned Tests/: no other suggestions.isEmpty waits remain; Tab-cycle tests use synchronous preview helpers, unchanged. bj.9 review: router/controller/view/field/BobProcessClient/models/DependencyDecodingTests/fake-bob compile-clean by inspection (consumeKey, previewLines/footerItems, selectAll, @testable envelope all resolve); fixtures relations-rename-dry-run.json + relation-label-parse-fixup.json decode. Verification: swift-format lint exit 0 (only pre-existing warnings, none in touched files) on athena; swift build --build-tests exit 0 (36.9s) on athena; DependencyDecodingTests rename+parse tests 2/2 pass on athena. Mac offline (ssh mac timeout twice), so BobMacCapture typecheck-tests + XCTest runs UNVERIFIED; macOS CI (phase 12.3) is the compile gate. No docs changes (no behavior contract changed), docs-check not run.

Verified: swift-format lint exit 0 on athena (no errors in touched files); swift build --build-tests exit 0 on athena; DependencyDecodingTests testRelationRenameDryRunDecodes + testRelationParseMarkersDecodeRangesAndHidden 2/2 pass on athena; fixed 5 Build errors (refusal fields to failedRename, 3 lets to vars), corrected rank-test query to '  IMPLE ', switched 2 Shift+Return waits to catalogLoaded; mac offline so BobMacCapture typecheck/XCTest unverified — left for 12.3 CI gate; no docs changes; no epic-symbols.
